cohort: The study included 151 pregnant women diagnosed with Intrahepatic Cholestasis of Pregnancy (ICP) and 158 age-matched healthy pregnant controls.
finding: Six HCMV-encoded miRNAs (hcmv-miR-UL22A-5p, hcmv-miR-US4-5p, hcmv-miR-US4-3p, hcmv-miR-UL112-5p, hcmv-miR-UL148D, and hcmv-miR-US25-2-5p) were significantly upregulated in ICP patients and showed promise as novel diagnostic molecular markers.
cross-section timing: During the second and third trimesters of pregnancy, based on the timing of ICP diagnosis.
